description: Behavioral test registry for marketing plugin skills

test_cases.description: product-marketing-context activates for brand positioning task
test_cases.prompt: I need to define our brand positioning and messaging pillars for a new product launch. We need to understand our ICP and create consistent marketing copy across channels.
test_cases.notes: Core positive case — brand/positioning keywords should trigger product-marketing-context

test_cases.description: social-media-strategy activates for social media planning
test_cases.prompt: Create a social media content calendar for Q2. We need a strategy covering LinkedIn, Twitter, and Instagram with consistent posting cadence and engagement tactics.

test_cases.description: content-strategy activates for content planning task
test_cases.prompt: Plan a content strategy for our blog and newsletter. We need to map content to funnel stages, define our editorial calendar, and establish SEO-driven topic clusters.
test_cases.notes: Content strategy/planning keywords should trigger content-strategy skill
